title: Scale response visual acceptance alignment

scope.subject: Align the existing Playwright visual midpoint matrix with the approved continuous-scale response map across desktop, tablet, mobile and WebGL-heavy lanes without weakening renderer, handoff, readability, or single-Canvas assertions

research_summary: The current visual suite already reuses Playwright, shared visualCase helpers, responsive viewport matrices, renderer diagnostics, screenshots, traces and hosted sharding. The scale-input product change intentionally moved the one-sample System midpoint from 1.500 to 1.333 and the one-sample Atmosphere midpoint from 4.500 to 4.400. Reuse the existing visual acceptance framework and update only those expected product coordinates; do not add a second screenshot framework, relax readiness assertions, or hide real renderer failures.

sources.finding: Playwright locator assertions auto-retry against live browser state and remain the existing mechanism for scale position, renderer, handoff and layout acceptance.
Playwright already provides browser screenshots and integrates with the repository visualCase evidence path, so no separate capture framework is needed for tuned scale midpoints.

search_ladder.conclusion: No external product-level visual suite should replace the repository acceptance matrix for product-specific scale coordinates and renderer diagnostics.
Keep Playwright Test as the browser lifecycle, retrying assertion, screenshot and trace framework.
Keep the existing hosted shard matrix and WebGL-heavy lane so response changes are validated under the same release topology.
Reuse current visualCase, dispatchVisualWheel and responsive viewport helpers; change only the expected tuned coordinate.

candidates.name: Existing Playwright visualCase midpoint matrix
candidates.source: Current tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts helpers and hosted CI
candidates.reason: Already covers desktop/tablet/mobile, WebGL-heavy rendering, screenshots, readability, handoff state and one-Canvas acceptance; only product-coordinate expectations became stale.

candidates.name: New custom scale screenshot harness
candidates.reason: Would duplicate the existing Playwright visual evidence path and add maintenance without improving renderer or interaction truthfulness.

coverage_matrix.capability: Desktop, tablet and mobile midpoint coordinates match the approved response map
coverage_matrix.decision: Update stale one-sample coordinate assertions inside the existing responsive visual matrix.

coverage_matrix.capability: Renderer, handoff, readability, screenshots and WebGL-heavy evidence remain unchanged
coverage_matrix.decision: Preserve every non-coordinate visual assertion and existing hosted lane.

decision.rationale: Reuse the existing Playwright visual acceptance system and change only stale coordinate expectations introduced by the approved response mapping. The suite must continue to assert real renderer/handoff/readability behavior.
decision.fallback: If a visual case still fails after coordinate alignment, diagnose the renderer/readiness/composition defect from its screenshot and trace; do not loosen timeouts or drop visual assertions.
